name: full
description: Full KDG-Tree / MRG-Tree structural pipeline used as the reference setting.

name: greedy_frontier
description: Replace frontier tree search with greedy single-path expansion that selects the highest-scoring service choice at each step.

name: wo_service_aware_planning
description: Do not expose the Stage2 similar-service context to the Stage3 sequence planner.

name: wo_length_prior
description: Remove the historical length hint and let the Stage3 planner decide the number of capability steps on its own.

name: hard_length_prior
description: Treat the historical length prior as an exact capability-step count constraint during Stage3 planning.

name: wo_history_prior
description: Disable the history-based service prior during tree reasoning while keeping the rest of the pipeline unchanged.

name: wo_state_dominance
description: Disable state-dominance pruning during frontier tree reasoning to measure its contribution to search efficiency.
